newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures lower in bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures lower in bearish sentiment.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures extended early losses to end lower on Thursday on technical selling in continued bearish sentiment, Japanese traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.6 yen to 4.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark December was down 2.0 yen at 112.0 yen.
"Sporadic selling emerged from the outset. After a moderate recovery earlier this week, private investors were quick to sell on the slightest rebound in prices," one trader said.
Traders said the key to direction is whether the International Rubber Organization (INRO) will intervene in the market to prop up prices.
